tagline: 徕卡胶片相机，1999 年发布
description: 徕卡于1999年推出的胶片相机。配备1:4.8-1:9.5/23-70mm zoom (7 separate lenses)。快门速度1 - 1/600 sec.。Active infra-red system。

specs.取景器: virtual image type, picture frame changes to match selected picture format
specs.闪光灯: reaching as far as 2 meters for a 100 ASA film with lens in wide angle position
specs.重量: 210 g (8 oz.) without the CR2 battery
specs.英文简介: The Leica C11 was one of the best compact zoom cameras for the APS film system, the only one made by Leica Camera AG.
